label: jaywalking
caption: A delivery rider on a moped slows down and puts a foot on the road to let a car pass. The detector loses the moped for those frames, and at that moment the rider is too slow for our speed test to flag him as a rider, so he counts as a pedestrian standing in the junction box.

label: failure_to_yield
caption: Two men wait at the kerb end of the zebra for their walk phase while a car with a green light drives past them. One of them stands on the end of the stripes and, for 0.7 s, passes both our kerb margin and our walking test, so the rule counts him as out on the crossing.

label: stop_line
caption: Cars in the median lane crossed the line on green, then waited about 20 s behind a car turning at the median nose. When the light went red they were still past the line, and the rule called it a stop-line violation. Our labels say it is not one; the task's definition could be read either way.

label: red_light
caption: A scooter creeps over the stop line about 0.9 s before green, while the red and amber lamps are lit together. Our lamp reader calls red plus amber 'yellow', and the rule also ignores crossings less than 1.5 s before green, so it never counts this one.

label: congestion
caption: The southbound junction box fills up and jams through a whole green, but the jam crawls at 1 to 2 m/s instead of standing still. The rule only counts vehicles that stand, so it never sees 8 of them on green.

label: jaywalking
caption: A man walks up the road beside the west zebra, coming in at the bottom edge of the frame. While his feet are below the frame his foot point sits on the image edge, outside the area the rule checks, so it sees only 0.6 s of him off the crossing and needs 1 s.
